notes.notes: [list][*][p]1.Adjusted the basic hit sound effect.[/p][/*][*][p]2.Normal attacks can now be performed while moving.[/p][/*][*][p]3.Added contact splash effect.[/p][/*][*][p]4.Added audio compressor.[/p][/*][*][p]5.Changed the configuration file path.[/p][/*][*][p]6.Changed the save file path.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Issue with the position marker of the guide prompt
notes.notes: The guide prompt's marker is incorrect for the NPC's position

notes.title: Issue with the position of the Element Disc
notes.notes: Fixed the issue with the position of the Element Disc

notes.title: Issue of UI font being too small at high resolutions
notes.notes: Fixed the issue where the UI font appeared too small in windowed mode with high resolutions (the actual issue was that the entire UI was too small).

notes.title: Added a mini-map and some necessary prompts
notes.notes:
1.Unified the terms "Library" and "Bookstore."
2.When enemies are present within a certain range, attack skills can no longer trigger dialogues.
3.Added a prompt to guide new players to save points.
4.Added a mini-map.
5.Fixed the issue where the greyed-out dialogue button could be triggered by a key press.
6.Various other issues.
